SignageCloudVideo.title: SignageCloudVideo
SignageCloudVideo.description: Represents a video item in the user's real-time cloud signage loop.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this signage video.

title.description: Display title of the video campaign.

videoUrl.description: Direct MP4/WebM stream URL for playback.

durationSeconds.description: Duration of the video in seconds.

order.description: Playback order in the gapless loop.

isForcedPlay.description: Whether this video is part of an active multi-video force-play selection.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

SignageCloudDevice.title: SignageCloudDevice
SignageCloudDevice.description: Represents a paired Android TV signage screen and its per-device orientation settings.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this device.

deviceId.description: Unique hardware/app identifier of the Android TV.

name.description: Friendly display name of the TV screen.

pairCode.description: 6-digit pairing code of the TV screen.

status.description: Current playback status reported by the TV.

screenOrientation.description: Target display orientation for this TV screen.

videoOrientation.description: Target video aspect/orientation mode for this TV screen.

currentVideoTitle.description: Title of the currently playing video on this TV.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

SignageCloudConfig.title: SignageCloudConfig
SignageCloudConfig.description: Global broadcast configuration and instant force-play command state for the user's signage network.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this config.

pushedVideoId.description: ID of the video to immediately play across connected TVs.

pushedVideoTimestamp.description: Epoch milliseconds of the last force-play command.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/videos/{videoId}.description: Real-time cloud playlist videos scoped per authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/devices/{deviceId}.description: Real-time paired Android TV devices and orientation state scoped per authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/config/{configId}.description: Real-time signage broadcast configuration scoped per authenticated user.
